---
id: green-iguana
title: Green iguana
---
The green iguana (*Iguana iguana*) is an arboreal herbivore of Central
and South American canopy. A dewlap and a spiny crest are display
organs; a long tail is a whip and a balancer. Hindgut microbes digest
leaves. Feral populations now occupy parts of Florida and the Caribbean.
Basking and shade-seeking keep the body in a narrow thermal window.
